SELECT
accommodation_id as accommodationId,
region_type as regionType, region_code as regionCode,
accommodation_type as accommodationType,
accommodation_type as accommodationType, region_type as regionType, region_code as regionCode,
SUM(view_count) as viewCount, SUM(reservation_count) as reservationCount, SUM(review_count) as reviewCount FROM popularity_stats WHERE period_type = 'DAILY' AND period_value BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND stats_type = #{statsType}
AND accommodation_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY accommodation_id
AND region_type IS NOT NULL AND region_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY region_type, region_code
AND accommodation_type IS NOT NULL GROUP BY accommodation_type
AND accommodation_type IS NOT NULL AND region_type IS NOT NULL AND region_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY accommodation_type, region_type, region_code
AND 1=0

INSERT INTO popularity_stats ( stats_type, region_type, region_code, accommodation_id, accommodation_type, period_type, period_value, reservation_count, view_count, review_count, popularity_score, top_n_rank, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES
( #{item.statsType}, #{item.regionType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.regionCode, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{item.accommodationId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{item.accommodationType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.periodType}, #{item.periodValue}, #{item.reservationCount, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{item.viewCount, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{item.reviewCount, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{item.popularityScore, jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{item.topNRank, jdbcType=INTEGER}, NOW(), NOW() )
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE reservation_count = VALUES(reservation_count), view_count = VALUES(view_count), review_count = VALUES(review_count), popularity_score = VALUES(popularity_score), top_n_rank = VALUES(top_n_rank), -- upsert 시 랭크도 같이 업데이트 할 수 있음 updated_at = NOW()

mapper.select: SELECT ps.*, a.title as accommodation_title, img.image_url as accommodation_main_image_url, s.sido_name as sido_name, s.sido_img_url as sido_img_url FROM popularity_stats ps LEFT JOIN accommodations a ON ps.accommodation_id = a.accommodation_id LEFT JOIN images img ON ps.accommodation_id = img.reference_id AND img.reference_type = 'ACCOMMODATION' AND img.is_main = true LEFT JOIN sidos s ON ps.region_type = 'SIDO' AND ps.region_code = s.sido_code WHERE ps.stats_type = #{statsType} AND ps.period_type = #{periodType} AND ps.period_value = #{periodValue} ORDER BY ps.popularity_score DESC, ps.reservation_count DESC, ps.view_count DESC, ps.review_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}
